basics.name: Kyle M. Anderson

work.name: DSTax Technologies
work.summary: Technical lead, lead developer, and project manager for a tax-integration platform, supporting development, implementation, and client needs.
highlights: Managed internal development projects and client-coordinated work, communicating integration updates, project status, and responses to questions and requests.
Supported end-to-end integration implementations, from requirements gathering and setup through troubleshooting and go-live support.
Developed integrations between financial platforms and tax providers, supporting Acumatica, Chargebee, Sage Intacct, WooCommerce, Magento/Adobe Commerce, Thomson Reuters, Vertex, Sovos, and SureTax.
Led the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 of the tax-integration platform, broadened platform and tax-provider support, and improved UI/UX.
Optimized asynchronous operations to improve performance and throughput.
Migrated production workloads from DigitalOcean to AWS.
Created and maintained client guides and knowledge-base articles.

work.name: Colectivo Coffee Roasters
highlights: Fulfilled orders for more than 1000 restaurant and store clients and updated invoices for inventory changes to maintain accurate records.
Partnered with the IT department to install and troubleshoot new point-of-sale nodes.

work.name: Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global)
highlights: Analyzed asset and facilities databases, identifying more than $10 million in previously unidentified asset value that informed the sale of unused assets before Komatsu's acquisition of Joy Global.
Evaluated, selected, and implemented a global mapping platform that provided facility information to employees and customers.
Initiated web automations that reduced manual database-maintenance work.
Managed SharePoint sites and data and designed data-input forms to improve accessibility, reduce errors, and support cross-department information sharing.

education.area: Industrial Engineering and Supply Chain/Operations Management

coverLetter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am interested in the Sr. Software Engineer position at Molson Coors. My background combines software development, systems integration, project coordination, and client support, with responsibility for translating operational requirements into working software. At DSTax Technologies, I serve as a technical lead and lead developer for a tax-integration platform. The role’s emphasis on understanding business processes, guiding delivery, and improving performance connects directly with my experience supporting integrations from requirements gathering through implementation and ongoing troubleshooting.

One example is my work leading the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 of the DSTax tax-integration platform. That work included broadening financial-platform and tax-provider support, improving UI/UX, and optimizing asynchronous operations to improve performance and throughput. I also managed internal development projects and client-coordinated work, sharing status and integration updates while responding to questions and requests. The integrations I supported included WooCommerce, Magento/Adobe Commerce, Acumatica, and Sage Intacct, providing relevant experience connecting e-commerce and financial systems. A second example comes from Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global), where I evaluated, selected, and implemented a global mapping platform that made facility information available to employees and customers. I also initiated web automations to reduce manual database maintenance and designed SharePoint data-input forms to improve accessibility and reduce errors. These efforts connected operational information needs with practical technology choices and more usable processes.

I would welcome the opportunity to bring this experience to Molson Coors’ commercial technology work. The position’s combination of business problem-solving, connected platforms, and technical leadership offers a clear connection to the work I have done developing and supporting business integrations. Thank you for considering my application; I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss how that experience could contribute to your software engineering team.
Sincerely,
Kyle M. Anderson
reviewNotes: Emphasized technical leadership, end-to-end integrations, e-commerce platforms, performance optimization, AWS migration, and stakeholder communication. The master does not establish Salesforce experience, expert proficiency in three languages, formal engineer coaching or design-standard ownership, Director-level communication, or broad CRM and marketing-platform experience. DevOps tools are listed, but detailed practices are not documented.
